name: io.github.Maarmapa/storefront-mcp
description: E-commerce storefront over MCP: public catalog tools plus token-gated back-office tools.

environmentVariables.name: CATALOG_ADAPTER
environmentVariables.description: Which catalog adapter to use: "memory" (bundled demo catalog, no setup) or "woocommerce" (Store API skeleton).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the sensitive back-office tools (stock, orders, sales) when the adapter provides them. On stdio the presence of this variable in the server process env unlocks them; leave it unset to expose only the public tools.

environmentVariables.name: CHECKOUT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Kill switch for create_checkout: "off" (not announced), "dry" (runs every guard rail and creates nothing) or "live". Only the exact string "live" arms it.

environmentVariables.name: STOCK_ALERT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Kill switch for subscribe_stock_alert: "off", "dry" (no email leaves) or "live". Only the exact string "live" arms it.

environmentVariables.name: STOCK_ALERT_SIGNING_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: HMAC key for double opt-in confirmation links, minimum 32 characters. Without a usable one no link can be issued and subscribe_stock_alert refuses — it never subscribes anyone without confirmation.

environmentVariables.name: STOCK_ALERT_CONFIRM_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public URL of the opt-in confirmation page (GET renders a button, POST performs the write). Required for STOCK_ALERT_MODE=live: with no URL the tool refuses instead of mailing a dead link. `storefront-mcp --http` serves that page at /api/stock-alert/confirm.

environmentVariables.name: CHECKOUT_UNRESERVED
environmentVariables.description: In live mode, what to do when the inventory adapter cannot HOLD units: "refuse" (default, no order is created) or "allow" (accepts that concurrent calls can oversell).

environmentVariables.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: Name of the header your edge writes with the client IP (e.g. x-vercel-forwarded-for, cf-connecting-ip). Unset means forwarding headers are ignored, because without a proxy a caller can write them.

environmentVariables.name: STOCK_ALERT_PAGE_LOCALE
environmentVariables.description: Language of the customer-facing opt-in confirmation page: "en" (default) or "es".
